Compute the modulation term $M_i = \kappa_t \cdot s(P_i) \cdot (1 - d_i) \cdot (1 - \alpha_{i-1})$.

The source provides a specific 4-multiplication implementation for $x^{(a \cdot y)^b}$.
We implement the opacity exponentiation as described.
**Finalize:** The final pixel color is $c_{final}$ and opacity is $\alpha_{final}$.
